svg.text: The piece funnels from one thesis into three parallel historical case studies of workless societies, which
converge on a single argument about what work actually gives us.

g.text: After Work, We'll Have Each Other — overview
An opening thesis fans into three historical case studies of relational societies, which converge on a final argument
about what paid work really supplies.

Versailles aristocrats, freed of work entirely, organized life around heraldic precedence and gossip rather than ideas
— a civilized but primate-like dominance game, not an inevitable one.

keeping class status in order, through performed charity work rather than achievement.
